id: \bOlympia uses Psychic type Pokémon. They are weak against the Bug, Ghost, and Dark types.
en: \bOlympia uses Psychic type Pokémon. They are weak against the Bug, Ghost, and Dark types.
it: \bOlympia usa Pokémon di tipo Psico. Sono deboli contro i tipi Coleottero, Spettro e Buio.

id: \bThey are strong against Fighting and Poison. Psychic and Fighting moves also don't do much damage.
en: \bThey are strong against Fighting and Poison.  Psychic and Fighting moves also don't do much damage.
it: \bSono forti contro Lotta e Veleno.  Anche le mosse Psico e Lotta non fanno loro molto danno.
\rSpero per te che tu abbia un tipo Buio.

id: \rTM119 contains Light Screen. It filters special damage deal to your team for five turns.
en: \rTM119 contains Light Screen. It filters special damage deal to your team for five turns.
it: \rLa MT119 contiene Schermoluce. Riduce i danni speciali subiti dalla tua squadra per cinque turni.

id: \rOlympia: Kalos is counting on you. Don't let us down.
en: \rOlympia: Kalos is counting on you. Don't let us down.
it: \rAstra: Kalos conta su di te. Non deluderci.
